title: Prevent path traversal in file uploads
description: `src/files.js` serves files from an uploads directory, but `resolveUpload` can be tricked into returning paths outside of it (path traversal). Fix it according to the rules in its doc comment so that no user-supplied name can escape `baseDir`, while legitimate nested names keep working. `test/files.test.js` includes traversal attempts, a sibling-directory prefix trick and a symlink escape.
